title: pyrola incarnata var. japonica
intro: Pyrola incarnata var. japonica, commonly known as Japanese wintergreen or pyrola, is a species of flowering plant in the heath family (Ericaceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various ailments, including digestive issues and inflammation, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Japanese wintergreen include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in wound healing and pain relief. The bioactive constituents of Pyrola incarnata var. japonica include methyl salicylate, salicylic acid, and other phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
